questions.zh: 请做一个简短的自我介绍（200字以内）
questions.en: Tell us about yourself (under 150 words)

questions.zh: 你的优点和不足是什么？
questions.en: What are your key strengths and an area you are working to improve?

questions.zh: 请谈谈你未来3-5年的职业规划
questions.en: Where do you see your career in 3-5 years?

questions.zh: 你为什么选择我们公司？
questions.en: Why do you want to work for us?

questions.zh: 你为什么申请这个岗位？你的优势是什么？
questions.en: Why are you interested in this role, and what makes you a good fit?

questions.zh: 你对本行业的理解和看法
questions.en: What do you know about our industry and its key trends?

questions.zh: 请描述一件你最有成就感的事
questions.en: Describe the achievement you are most proud of

questions.zh: 请描述你遇到的最大困难以及你是如何解决的
questions.en: Describe a significant challenge you faced and how you overcame it

questions.zh: 请举例说明一次团队合作的经历，以及你在其中的角色
questions.en: Give an example of working in a team and the role you played

questions.zh: 请描述一次你组织或带领他人完成任务的经历
questions.en: Describe a time you showed leadership

questions.zh: 请分享一次失败的经历以及你的收获
questions.en: Tell us about a time you failed and what you learned

questions.zh: 当你和同事意见不一致时，你会如何处理？
questions.en: How do you handle a disagreement with a colleague?

questions.zh: 请举例说明你如何快速学习一项新技能
questions.en: Give an example of how you quickly learned a new skill

questions.zh: 期望薪资
questions.en: What are your salary expectations?

questions.zh: 最快到岗时间
questions.en: When are you available to start?

questions.zh: 是否能接受加班和出差？
questions.en: Are you comfortable with occasional overtime or travel?

questions.zh: 是否接受岗位调剂或异地工作？
questions.en: Are you open to other locations or roles?

questions.zh: 您是从哪里得知本次招聘信息的？
questions.en: How did you hear about this opportunity?

questions.zh: 目前是否已获得其他公司的录用通知？
questions.en: Are you currently interviewing elsewhere or holding other offers?

questions.zh: 你的兴趣爱好有哪些？
questions.en: What do you enjoy doing outside work or study?

questions.zh: 你在澳洲的工作权利是什么？
questions.en: Do you have the right to work in Australia? Please describe your visa status.

questions.zh: 离职通知期是多久？
questions.en: What is your notice period?

questions.zh: 请简要说明你为什么适合这个岗位（求职信摘要）
questions.en: Briefly explain why you are a strong candidate for this role (cover letter summary)

questions.zh: 我们的哪项价值观最打动你？为什么？
questions.en: Which of our values resonates with you most, and why?
